name: Nils Ušakovs, Michalis Hadjipantela - Après le § 38 - Am 98
title: REPORT on the Council position on the draft general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2027
part_text: 38a. Opposes the introduction of new own resources for the Union; emphasises that the implementation of the Commission’s proposals in this regard would further increase the tax burden on citizens and businesses;
